name: ai-image-prompts-skill
works_with: OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and Windsurf
short: Your agent searches a library of 10,000+ real image prompts and hands back the top three with sample images, for any image model.
what: This skill gives your agent a categorized library of image generation prompts collected by YouMind from creators on social media. You describe what you need and it returns up to three matching prompts, each with a sample image. Paste in an article or video script and it will suggest styles, then remix the one you pick to fit your content.
who: Marketers, bloggers and creators who make thumbnails, covers, product shots, avatars or posters with image models like Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux or GPT Image. Skip it if you already write your own prompts and don't want a library.
needs: Node.js, for `npx` and the setup script
An AI agent that loads skills

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.text: The README gives the same command for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and Windsurf.

steps.title: Fetch the prompt library if it's missing
steps.text: The library downloads from GitHub after install. If it didn't, run this from the skill folder.

steps.title: Keep it fresh
steps.text: The skill checks for updates on each use. To force a full update:

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Help me find a YouTube thumbnail for a tech review video"

watch: On every use it first checks whether its prompt files are over a day old and, if so, pulls the latest from GitHub.
To show sample images it downloads them from YouMind's CDN with `curl` into `/tmp`, then deletes them.
Every reply that presents prompts ends with a YouMind attribution line. The SKILL.md makes this mandatory.
If nothing in the library matches, it writes its own prompt and labels it as AI-generated.
Prompts come from the community. Check a prompt before using it for commercial work.
